correctness.rationale: Coordinate stationarity gives E[y]=-m, E[x]=-am, and E[x^2]=bm. The exact coboundary L(z+bx-(b/a)y)=x^2+(b/a)x gives the shifted mean-square circle. Variation of constants forces z>=0 on every bounded complete trajectory and z>0 off the origin. The two equilibrium endpoints and the slab-excursion rigidity follow directly. The exact algebra checker returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: Sprott F is a canonical simple chaotic flow with documented periodic and chaotic parameter regions. The theorem adds a global exact constraint on every compact recurrent statistical state, identifies the two extremal equilibrium states, and forces any other recurrent state to make excursions on both sides of a natural equilibrium slab. The result is structural rather than a numerical recomputation or arbitrary parameter slice.
